buildCommand: echo 'Static Verse site: source files are ready'
ignoreCommand: if [ -n "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" ] && git cat-file -e "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" 2>/dev/null && git diff --quiet "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" HEAD -- site vercel.json; then exit 1; fi; if git cat-file -e HEAD^ 2>/dev/null && git diff --quiet HEAD^ HEAD -- site vercel.json; then exit 1; fi
